zh-Hans: 不知道你在兴奋什么，该不会还想超过我吧？也太不自量力了！
en: I don't know what you're so excited about, but don't tell me you think you can pass me. That's pure arrogance!

zh-Hans: 就算天地翻过来，也不可能有人超过我！
en: Even if the world turned upside down, no one's getting past me!

zh-Hans: 说不上为什么，就是火大。那副得意样全写在脸上了！
en: I don't know why, but he pisses me off. I can tell he's getting cocky!

zh-Hans: 水平比预想的高点，不过还不至于让我慌张。
en: He's better than I expected, but not enough to worry me.

zh-Hans: 得找个地方把他超过去。
en: I'll have to find somewhere to pass him.

zh-Hans: 把压力顶到极限，逼出机会。倒要看看你能撑多久！
en: I'll pile on the pressure and force an opening. Let's see how long you can hold out!

zh-Hans: 我到底在干什么，真丢脸！
en: What am I doing? Pathetic!

zh-Hans: 这样岂不是显得我拿他没办法？！
en: This makes it look like I'm struggling with him!

zh-Hans: 这水平，直接参加东堂塾的比赛都够了。
en: He's good enough to compete in Todo School battles as he is.

zh-Hans: 心理素质真够强的，怎么施压都没反应。
en: He's mentally tough. No matter how much pressure I apply, I get nothing.

zh-Hans: 积压的这口气，我要一口气全发泄出来！
en: I'm going to let out all this pent-up frustration at once!

zh-Hans: 一瞬间就结束掉！
en: I'll end this in an instant!

zh-Hans: 哦？
en: Oh?

zh-Hans: 这展开，可不在我的预料之内。
en: I didn't see this turn of events coming.

zh-Hans: 怎么回事？
en: What's going on?

zh-Hans: 昨天是谁说，跟外面的车手比很轻松？开什么玩笑！
en: Who was it yesterday saying outsiders were easy to beat? What a joke!

zh-Hans: 怎么会这样？我可能犯了个挽回不了的大错。
en: What have I done? I may have made a mistake I can't take back.

zh-Hans: 这下不妙了！
en: This is bad!

zh-Hans: 什么？！
en: What?!

zh-Hans: 这家伙不只快，脑子也好使！
en: He's not just fast. He's smart too!

zh-Hans: 切！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 啧！
en: Tch!

zh-Hans: 难以置信！
en: I don't believe it!
Ugh...

zh-Hans: 真是打击不小。
en: That's quite a shock.

zh-Hans: 简直跟作弊一样。
en: This feels like cheating.

zh-Hans: 好快……不可能，骗人的吧……
en: Fast... No way... This can't be real...

zh-Hans: 好快……
en: Fast...

zh-Hans: 我最受不了那种轻浮的态度！
en: I can't stand that frivolous attitude!

zh-Hans: 就这样？赶紧结束吧！
en: Is that all? Let's get this over with!

zh-Hans: 我跑到前面后，他竟然靠惊人的专注一直跟着。
en: Now that I'm ahead, he's staying with me through sheer concentration.

zh-Hans: 明明不可能跟上的，为什么你还在那儿？！
en: You shouldn't be able to keep up! Why are you still there?!

zh-Hans: 甩不掉，怎么会这样？！
en: I can't shake him! How is this happening?!

zh-Hans: 好，接下来只要甩掉他就结束了！
en: Good. Now I'll pull away and finish this!

zh-Hans: 真简单。
en: Too easy.

zh-Hans: 这才是东堂塾的跑法，跟山路车手可不是一个层次！
en: This is how Todo School drives. We're not on the same level as mountain racers!

zh-Hans: 哼。
en: Hmph.

zh-Hans: 哈！
en: Hah!

zh-Hans: 也就这样了！
en: That's how it's done!

zh-Hans: 别小看我！
en: Don't underestimate me!

zh-Hans: 该结束了！
en: Time to end this!

zh-Hans: 别得意忘形！
en: Don't get cocky!

zh-Hans: 真提不起劲，连一点让我热血起来的东西都找不到。
en: What a drag. There's nothing here to get me fired up.

zh-Hans: 我还没达到馆前辈当年的水平！
en: I'm still not at Tomo's level back in his racing days!

zh-Hans: 真扫兴，完全是白跑一趟！
en: What a letdown. A complete waste of time!

zh-Hans: 被摆了一道！在我最擅长的刹车上，反倒是我被超了！
en: He got me! I was passed under braking, my strongest point!

zh-Hans: 我的 CIVIC，可是最强的 TYPE R！
en: My CIVIC is the ultimate TYPE R!

zh-Hans: 我只是想让你见识一下，世上真正快的人多得很！
en: I just want to show you how many truly fast drivers are out there!
